notes.title: from selenium import webdriver
notes.content:
import time
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from webdriver_manager.chrome import ChromeDriverManager

from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
import json

navegador = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service(ChromeDriverManager().install()))
navegador.maximize_window()
navegador.get("https://cremesp.org.br/?siteAcao=cid10")

wait = WebDriverWait(navegador, 20)

# entra no iframe pelo id
iframe = wait.until(
    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.ID, "fraIncludePaginaResponsivel"))
)
navegador.switch_to.frame(iframe)

# espera o select aparecer
wait.until(
    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.NAME, "tbCategorias_length"))
)

# altera o select para 3000 registros
navegador.execute_script("""
var select = document.getElementsByName('tbCategorias_length')[0];
var option = select.querySelector("option[value='100']");
option.value = "3000";
option.text = "3000";
select.value = "3000";
select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
""")

# espera carregar todas as linhas
wait.until(EC.presence_of_all_elements_located((By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tbCategorias"]/tbody')))

tabela = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tbCategorias"]/tbody')))

linhas = navegador.find_elements(By.XPATH, '//tr[@class="odd" or @class="even"]')
print(len(linhas))

def processar_linha(linha):
    codigo = linha.find_element(By.XPATH, './td[1]').text
    descricao = linha.find_element(By.XPATH, './td[2]').text
    print(codigo, descricao)

    botao_visualizar = linha.find_element(By.XPATH, './td[3]/button[1]')
    botao_visualizar.click()

    # espera o detalhe aparecer
    detalhe = WebDriverWait(navegador, 10).until(
        EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tabela_body"]/tr[1]/td[2]'))
    )

    # pega todos os novos TRs
    novos_trs = navegador.find_elements(By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tabela_body"]/tr')
    for tr in novos_trs:
        sub_codigo = tr.find_element(By.XPATH, './td[1]').text
        if sub_codigo.startswith(codigo):
            processar_linha(tr)

# loop inicial
linhas = navegador.find_elements(By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tabela_body"]/tr')
for linha in linhas:
    processar_linha(linha)

time.sleep(5)

notes.title: from selenium import webdriver
notes.content:
import time
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from webdriver_manager.chrome import ChromeDriverManager

from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
import json

navegador = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service(ChromeDriverManager().install()))
navegador.maximize_window()
navegador.get("https://cremesp.org.br/?siteAcao=cid10")

wait = WebDriverWait(navegador, 20)

# entra no iframe pelo id
iframe = wait.until(
    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.ID, "fraIncludePaginaResponsivel"))
)
navegador.switch_to.frame(iframe)

# espera o select aparecer
wait.until(
    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.NAME, "tbCategorias_length"))
)

# altera o select para 3000 registros
navegador.execute_script("""
var select = document.getElementsByName('tbCategorias_length')[0];
var option = select.querySelector("option[value='100']");
option.value = "3000";
option.text = "3000";
select.value = "3000";
select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
""")

# espera carregar todas as linhas
wait.until(EC.presence_of_all_elements_located((By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tbCategorias"]/tbody')))

# tabela = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//*[@id="tbCategorias"]/tbody')))

linhas = navegador.find_elements(By.XPATH, '//tr[@class="odd" or @class="even"]')
print(f"Total de linhas: {len(linhas)}")

dados_tabela = []

for i, linha in enumerate(linhas, start=1):
    codigo = linha.find_element(By.XPATH, './td[1]').text
    descricao = linha.find_element(By.XPATH, './td[2]').text
    
    dados_tabela.append({
        "codigo": codigo,
        "descricao": descricao
    })
    print(f"{i}: {codigo} - {descricao}")

import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame(dados_tabela)
df.to_excel("categorias.xlsx", index=False)


time.sleep(5)
